title: T-Mobile BOPIS Experience
jpTitle: T-Mobile オンライン購入・店舗受取体験

summary.en: Led UX across an integrated three-touchpoint Buy-Online-Pickup-In-Store solution for T-Mobile: a Customer Care App for staff, a self-serve kiosk and locker system, and a voice AI chatbot for pre-visit questions — closing the gap between a digital order and a physical pickup. Selected as T-Mobile's preferred innovation partner.
summary.jp: T-Mobile のオンライン注文と店舗受け取りをつなぐ 3 つの仕組みを設計した。店員用アプリ、無人の受け取りロッカー、来店前の質問に答える音声 AI。デジタルの注文と実際の受け取りの間の溝を埋めた。

business.en: T-Mobile selected this as its preferred innovation partner after the engagement — evidence the three-touchpoint model (app, kiosk/locker, voice AI) solved a real operational gap, not just a design exercise.
business.jp: 案件の後、T-Mobile の優先パートナーに選ばれた。アプリ・ロッカー・音声 AI の 3 点セットが、単なる設計演習でなかった証。実際の運用課題を解いた。

mine: Designed the integrated three-component solution bridging the digital-to-physical gap
Customer Care App: real-time visibility into incoming orders and customer profiles for store staff
Self-serve kiosk and locker: check-in, modify orders, retrieve products independently
Voice AI chatbot: pre-visit questions and pickup guidance
Led design across all three touchpoints and mapped the complete purchase-to-pickup journey
team: Experience Designer, Product Designer, Industrial Designer, Service Designer, Business Analyst and Software Engineer — credited on the page by role title, without individual task breakdown separate from Takao's

label.en: selected as T-Mobile's preferred innovation partner
label.jp: 優先パートナーに選出

label.en: integrated touchpoints: app, kiosk/locker, voice AI

label.jp: 端末画面 12 超を制作

narrative.problem: BOPIS had a fundamental disconnection between digital and physical touchpoints — customers who ordered online couldn't seamlessly transition to in-store pickup, with a fragmented handoff requiring redundant steps and manual coordination.

_notes: Engagement recorded as freelance based on roles.json's Creativity Is Everywhere LLC (cie) role, whose evidence list includes tmobile; the project page itself doesn't restate this beyond site-wide footer boilerplate.
The page states all designs have had branding elements removed and visual details anonymized for confidentiality; outcomes are stated as factual by the page.

cardLine.en: Buy online, pick up in store — a staff app, a locker kiosk, and a voice bot.
cardLine.jp: オンラインで買って店で受け取る。店員アプリ、ロッカー、音声ボットの 3 点で。
